sentences.text: Author: Virender Singh Bench: Virender Singh Neeta Ram (deceased) through LRs & Ors. Vs. State .

Present: Mr. Romesh Verma, Senior Advocate, with Mr. Digvijay,
Advocate for the appellants.
Mr. Mohinder Zharaick, Additional Advocate General for respondent-State.
Learned Additional Advocate General placed on record instructions dated 10.07.2024, of Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division, Nohradhar, H.P.

Relevant paragraph 2 of the said said instructions, is reproduced, as under:-
"That the respondent department will proceed for acquisition of suit land as per Right and Fair Compensation Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation &
Resettlement Act, 2013.
The said acquisition process will take some time for settle the matter with the petitioner."
In view of the above, case is adjourned to 12.08.2024.

May 17, 2024 ( Virender Singh )
 (Gaurav Thakur) Judge Neeta Ram (Deceased) Through Lrs & Ors. vs . State on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102232682/
